name: smart-tha-pho
description: Smart Tha Pho municipal service platform

scripts.dev: npm-run-all --parallel dev:api dev:portal dev:prms dev:waste dev:disaster dev:water
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @smart-thapho/shared && npm run build --workspace @smart-thapho/portal && npm run build --workspace @smart-thapho/prms-tsm && npm run build --workspace @smart-thapho/waste-management && npm run build --workspace @smart-thapho/disaster-management && npm run build --workspace @smart-thapho/waterworks-management
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @smart-thapho/api && npm run test --workspace @smart-thapho/shared
